title: Power Automate: desktop flow libraries of reusable subflows
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and accurately distinguishes planned libraries from documented desktop flow templates. Power Automate Premium supports the stated desktop authoring entitlement; library-specific licensing, controls and behaviour remain explicitly unconfirmed.

claims.quote: enabling makers to create and publish libraries

claims.claim: Libraries will contain reusable automation building blocks called subflows for use across multiple desktop flows.
claims.quote: libraries with reusable automation building blocks (subflows) that can be used across multiple desktop flows

claims.claim: Libraries are intended to centralise commonly used automation logic.
claims.quote: Makers can centralize commonly used automation logic in libraries and reuse it across their solutions

claims.quote: reducing duplication

claims.claim: Microsoft's stated aims include promoting consistent automation practices.
claims.quote: promoting consistent automation practices

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe desktop flow libraries.

claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" published reference copy updates Flow checker data policies. Read roadmap and Create and manage desktop flow templates; no library reference-versus-copy behaviour found.

claims.claim: The Power Automate for desktop version required for libraries is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" publish consume permissions version rollout prerequisites connections credentials. Read roadmap and Create and manage desktop flow templates; the latter's v2.72+ prerequisite is for templates, not libraries.

claims.claim: Desktop flow templates help makers reuse and standardise automation logic across desktop flows.
claims.quote: A desktop flow template helps makers reuse and standardize automation logic across multiple desktop flows.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: A desktop flow created from a template is an independent copy.
claims.quote: A flow created from a template is an independent copy of that template.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Publishing an updated template does not update existing flows created from it.
claims.quote: Publishing an updated template makes the updated version available for future flows. Existing flows created from the template aren't updated.

claims.claim: Template co-owner permissions allow the recipient to edit the template.
claims.quote: A template shared with co-owner permissions can be edited by the recipient.

claims.claim: Template user permissions provide read-only access.
claims.quote: A template shared with user permissions is available as read-only.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: The default state is unknown: Microsoft has not stated what happens on arrival or whether admin enablement is required.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate "desktop flow libraries" environment tenant enable default PowerShell API. Read roadmap, Manage feature settings and desktop flow templates; no library default or admin-enablement requirement found.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not describe any change to existing unattended flows.
claims.quote: Power Automate will introduce desktop flow libraries, enabling makers to create and publish libraries with reusable automation building blocks (subflows) that can be used across multiple desktop flows.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes reusable building blocks, not an agent or autonomous behaviour.
claims.quote: libraries with reusable automation building blocks (subflows) that can be used across multiple desktop flows

claims.claim: Desktop automation actions may touch files.
claims.quote: Quickly organize your documents by using dedicated files and folders actions

claims.claim: Desktop automation actions may interact with applications.
claims.quote: It allows you to automate both legacy applications, such as terminal emulators, modern web and desktop applications, Excel files, and folders.

claims.claim: Desktop flows can use connector actions.
claims.quote: In desktop flows, you can utilize not only the standard set of actions available in the action library but also some of the most popular connectors.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft lists Power Automate Premium as providing the full set of desktop authoring capabilities.
claims.quote: We recommend the Power Automate Premium license for all users, as it gives them the full set of capabilities to create both API based and desktop automations.

claims.claim: The licensing model is included under the product's Power Automate Premium desktop authoring entitlement.
claims.quote: We recommend the Power Automate Premium license for all users, as it gives them the full set of capabilities to create both API based and desktop automations.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; summary; Cost and licensing; Scope; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Library-specific licensing terms are not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" licensing meter Dataverse storage price; "desktop flow libraries" reusable subflows Power Automate licensing sharing version. Read Types of Power Automate licenses and Premium RPA features; no library-specific terms found.

claims.claim: Premium RPA features lists UI elements collections for reuse across desktop flows.
claims.quote: UI elements collections | Create, share, and use groups of predefined UI elements in multiple desktop flows.

claims.claim: The Premium RPA features page does not list desktop flow libraries.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" reusable subflows Power Automate licensing sharing version. Opened and read Premium RPA features in full; UI elements collections and custom actions are listed, desktop flow libraries are not.

claims.claim: No library-specific meter is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" licensing meter Dataverse storage price. Read Types of Power Automate licenses and Premium RPA features; searched results for desktop flow libraries, including Pay-as-you-go meters excerpts; no library meter found.

claims.claim: Whether library content uses Dataverse storage is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" licensing meter Dataverse storage price. Read Types of Power Automate licenses and Premium RPA features; searched returned storage excerpts for desktop flow libraries; no library storage statement found.

claims.claim: The environments in scope for desktop flow libraries are not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate "desktop flow libraries" environment tenant enable default PowerShell API. Read roadmap and Manage feature settings; neither identifies library environment eligibility.

claims.claim: Library rollout mechanics are not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" publish consume permissions version rollout prerequisites connections credentials. Read roadmap and Manage feature settings; only roadmap target months, not library rollout mechanics, were found.

claims.claim: Library-specific prerequisites are not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" publish consume permissions version rollout prerequisites connections credentials. Read roadmap and Create and manage desktop flow templates; template prerequisites do not establish library prerequisites.

claims.where: controls[0] (both null sides); summary; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No library-specific environment or tenant availability control is documented in admin UI or API.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate "desktop flow libraries" environment tenant enable default PowerShell API. Opened Manage feature settings and searched its full text; reviewed Power Apps/Power Automate PowerShell search excerpts. No library availability switch or API found.

claims.claim: The Power Platform admin center Features page has environment-level settings for other desktop flow capabilities.
claims.quote: Find these settings in the Power Platform admin center for an environment. [...] Enable hosted machines. [...] Enable storage of desktop flow files into v2 schema.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that existing Features page desktop flow controls cover libraries.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate "desktop flow libraries" environment tenant enable default PowerShell API. Opened Manage feature settings; searched its full text for library and desktop settings. Its controls describe other capabilities, not library availability.

claims.claim: Existing Flow checker rules are available for desktop flows.
claims.quote: Static analysis is available in the Flow checker section of the designer. [...] Flow checker configuration applies at the environment level and affects all desktop flows within the selected environment.

claims.claim: Existing data policies can govern desktop flow actions.
claims.quote: Power Automate allows you to create and enforce DLP policies that classify desktop flow modules and individual module actions as Business, Non-business, or Blocked.

claims.claim: No source found says libraries change existing desktop flow behaviour on arrival.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" published reference copy updates Flow checker data policies; Power Automate "desktop flow libraries" environment tenant enable default PowerShell API. Read roadmap, templates and feature settings; no change to existing flows on arrival stated.
